hook: One copper-cobalt-cerium oxide catalyst both loads and releases hydrogen in carbazole carriers.
summary: A non-precious CuCoCeOx catalyst reshapes itself during reaction into Cu-CoOx interface sites that handle both hydrogenation and dehydrogenation of liquid organic hydrogen carriers. It took up 98.4% H2 and held steady for five cycles. Five cycles is short for judging durability.
title: Synergistic Cu-Co Sites Enabled Reversible H2 Storage and Release in Liquid Organic Hydrogen Carriers.
